name: cosmosfl
description: COSMosFL: an ensemble of small language models, each running AutoFL with COSMosFL's flattened-prompt protocol; the members' votes are combined by a weighted sum (equal weights by default)
reference: H. Cho, S. Kang, G. An, S. Yoo. COSMosFL: Ensemble of Small Language Models for Fault Localisation. LLM4Code 2025 (ICSE 2025 workshop).
